summary: Ported node:test-based test files in the subagents and workflows extensions to vitest, rewrote the workflows web entry, updated gizmo.registry.json catalog entries, bumped @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to ^0.84.4 across packages, removed unsupported `modelRegistry` fields from createAgentSession calls to satisfy the 0.84.4 type signature, and got tsc clean. The vitest run is mostly green (42/43 files, 134/139 tests) but workflows sandbox tests fail because `runWorkflowSandbox` rejects non-file URLs in its worker loader.
decisions: Hand-rewrite each test file from node:test to vitest with assert.* → expect.* mappings rather than scripting a mass conversion, because tricky cases like `assert.throws(fn, /regex/)` need custom handling.

Remove `modelRegistry` from the two createAgentSession call sites (subagents/src/manager.ts and workflows/src/runner.ts) to match pi-coding-agent 0.84.4's CreateAgentSessionOptions; the option was being silently ignored at runtime by 0.84.4 anyway, so behavior is preserved.
Bump @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent to ^0.84.4 in packages/extensions, packages/git, packages/unity-tools, and packages/unity so registry package versions agree.
errors: tsc --noEmit reported TS2353 in extensions/subagents/src/manager.ts(261,9) and extensions/workflows/src/runner.ts(314,7): 'modelRegistry' is not a known property of CreateAgentSessionOptions in pi-coding-agent 0.84.4. Fixed by removing the field from both call sites.

vitest run: 5 tests failing in extensions/workflows/src/sandbox.test.ts with TypeError "The URL must be of scheme file" thrown from sandbox.ts:106 (fileURLToPath on a non-file URL). Not yet fixed in this segment.
